findings.highlight: I should laze around after a meal
findings.evidenceJa: 食後はゆっくり、無理をせずゴロゴロすべし
findings.governingReading: after eating, one ought to take it easy, avoid exertion, and lounge about
findings.explanation: Shirou’s mock-prescriptive maxim loses both its performed tone and the injunction not to overdo things.

findings.highlight: Your body needs to use its energy for digestion
findings.evidenceJa: 消化にエネルギーを使うため脳の機能は低下するし
findings.governingReading: because energy is used for digestion, brain function declines
findings.explanation: The English retains digestion and energy but deletes the claimed consequence that explains Shirou’s torpor.

findings.highlight: they have no common interests to talk about
findings.evidenceJa: 共通の話題がない二人
findings.governingReading: the two have no common topics of conversation
findings.explanation: A lack of ready conversational material becomes a broader claim that Sakura and Saber share no interests.

findings.highlight: doing the dishes together as a way of bonding
findings.evidenceJa: 洗い物を一緒にする事で信頼を深めている
findings.governingReading: are deepening their trust by washing the dishes together
findings.explanation: The specific growth of mutual trust is replaced by generic bonding.

findings.evidenceJa: 息合ってるじゃないか、二人とも
findings.governingReading: you two are really in sync
findings.explanation: Shirou praises their coordinated work; mirror moon changes this to general social harmony.

findings.highlight: There’s some program for housewives on TV
findings.evidenceJa: なんとなく点けたテレビ
findings.governingReading: the television he turned on casually and without a particular reason
findings.explanation: The English removes Shirou’s incidental act and motive for turning on the television.

findings.evidenceJa: 昼過ぎの奥様向け番組まっさかり
findings.governingReading: in the thick of afternoon programming aimed at housewives
findings.explanation: The time and sense that this is the height of the daytime programming block disappear.

findings.evidenceJa: 心身ともにまったり空気に包まれながら
findings.governingReading: enveloped in an atmosphere that relaxes both body and mind
findings.explanation: A bodily and mental state is reduced to a generic peaceful mood.

findings.highlight: even half a day’s rest did the trick
findings.evidenceJa: 半日休んで元通りになった
findings.governingReading: half a day of rest returned him to normal
findings.explanation: mirror moon adds an emphatic “even,” implying that the recovery time was surprisingly short.

findings.evidenceJa: セイバーの問いに無言で頷く
findings.governingReading: I silently nod to Saber’s question
findings.explanation: The recurring translation invents a reciprocal nod and again omits Shirou’s silence.

findings.highlight: Magical skill doesn’t improve after only one day
findings.evidenceJa: 魔術の腕は一朝一夕で上がるものではない
findings.governingReading: magecraft ability is not something that improves overnight
findings.explanation: The alternate branch repeats the literalization of an idiom about sustained improvement into one day.

findings.governingReading: combat training should be a different matter
findings.explanation: The alternate branch again changes the immediate value of combat practice into a magical-versus-physical skill distinction.

findings.highlight: It won’t hurt to train until dinner
findings.evidenceJa: 残る半日、夕食までセイバーに稽古をつけてもらうのは無駄ではないだろう
findings.governingReading: having Saber train me for the remaining half day until dinner should not be useless
findings.explanation: The alternate branch again omits the half-day duration, Saber as instructor, and Shirou’s judgment of usefulness.
